text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding pilot customer in eu-north5, need p5 and g5 capacity plus ENI/IPv6 fallbacks. Can infra team advise on quota increases and subnet sizing? We want to deploy 6 p5 instances + 12 g5 across 3 AZs, prefer on-demand for canary then migrate to reserved.

raj: Do we have eu-north5 account enabled? AWS often needs accelerator entitlements for new regions. I'll need the account ID and exact instance types. Also confirm ENI and EIP expectations.

maria: Account is 987654321234. Instance types: p5.48xlarge, g5.48xlarge. Plan: start with 2 p5 + 4 g5, ramp to 6/12 in 2 weeks. Proposed subnets: /26 per AZ for ENI headroom, but worried about IPv4 exhaustion — would like IPv6 fallback.

sam: /26 per AZ (~62 hosts) should cover ENIs (each instance uses multiple). If we expect bursty autoscale, add an extra /27 as cushion. Alternatively request higher ENI quota; that keeps subnets smaller.

raj: For AWS Support case pick service 'Amazon EC2' -> 'Accelerator quota' and list 'Running On-Demand p5.48xlarge' and 'Running On-Demand g5.48xlarge'. Also open a VPC quota case: increase 'Elastic network interfaces per region' and 'Private IPv4 addresses per region' and ask to enable IPv6 for subnets.

maria: Can you draft the case? Also include a note on cost — p5 on-demand is pricier (~$X/hr) so finance sign-off needed if we go beyond canary.

esther: FYI if the workload needs RDMA/EFA mention it explicitly. Also call out placement groups if we want low-latency NVLink-like behavior in the cluster.

raj: Drafting now, will paste support body here.

raj: ```bash
aws support create-case \
  --subject "Increase p5/g5 accelerator quota in eu-north5 for pilot" \
  --service-code AmazonEC2 \
  --category-code other \
  --severity-code normal \
  --communication-body "We request increased Running On-Demand instance limits for p5.48xlarge (target 20) and g5.48xlarge (target 30) in eu-north5 for account 987654321234. Also request region-level ENI increase to 5000, private IPv4 addresses to 50000, and IPv6 support enabled for new subnets. Workload: Redwood Inference pilot, expected steady state 6 p5 + 12 g5. Contact: raj@redwood.example.com" \
  --issue-type "customer-service"
```

sam: Looks good. I'll also pre-raise a quota request via the AWS console for ENIs and IPv4 so we have parallel tracks.

maria: Timeline: need initial 2 p5 + 4 g5 in 4 business days. If support is slow, what's fallback? Any spare capacity in eu-north4 or eu-west-3 we can borrow?

raj: Fallback options: cross-region routing to eu-west-3 (latency + cost hit) or fall back to smaller instance shapes (g5.12xlarge) with more instances. I'll check spare pools and ask capacity planning.

infra-bot: Note added to onboarding-ops ticket #2345: 'eu-north5 p5/g5 quota request initiated by raj'.

maria: Thanks — please post the support case number when available and attach screenshots of console requests. :thumbsup:
